native_source_scope: Compare all 676 original metric.mAP JSON values, all 7304 printed native class AP values and native pred_count.txt image counts against the frozen CSVs.

precision_basis.native_mAP50: JSON metric.mAP and CSV native_mAP50 parsed as Python float; math.isclose uses rel_tol=1e-9 and abs_tol=1e-12 in native ratio units.
precision_basis.native_mAP50_acceptance_bound: abs(a-b) <= max(1e-9 * max(abs(a), abs(b)), 1e-12). This is a validation tolerance, not rounding or changing published values.
precision_basis.native_class_AP50: Exact dictionary equality after parsing the native printed class_ap.txt AP and CSV native_AP50 as float; original printed precision, usually three decimal places, is retained.
precision_basis.file_and_archive_integrity: Exact source byte sizes/SHA256; exact source whole-file MD5 versus Baidu PCS meta.block_list single entry and size. The listing md5 field is obfuscated and is not used as a genuine MD5. MD5 is not described as SHA256; no numerical tolerance.

checks: All six native files per 676 recorded evaluation roles are present
Unique physical source paths and unique archive members
Per-file SHA256 shape and nonnegative byte counts
No post-cutoff scientific files or model-weight files included
1267816 ROI NPZ files with exact per-group image counts for 132 groups
24 embedding groups: 72 data files and 168 plots
Each image-bearing archive contains attribution NOTICE and full CC BY-NC4.0 text

packaging_check.method: Small standard-library temporary fixtures, no new test framework
checks: Archive member bytes and per-file SHA256 match fixture source
Archive and manifest sizes/SHA256 match emitted registry
Exclude post-cutoff files, model weights and unlicensed pixel fixtures
Licensed image archives include the two required notice files and account for auxiliary entries

archive_integrity: Each source file's size and mtime_ns were checked before and after reading; file SHA256 was computed from the bytes given to tar. Each completed archive has an independent source-host SHA256. The ByPy uploader recomputes source SHA256 and MD5 from retained archives, rejects differing existing cloud files, and records exact Baidu provider size/MD5 matches per asset in artifact_manifest.json.

representative_large_archive_check.name: results-67-roi-0013.tar
representative_large_archive_check.provider_hash_semantics: The largest actual archive was streamed as one complete file using native ByPy slice_size=2147483648. PCS meta.block_list contained exactly one entry equal to independently computed MD5 of every source byte; no multipart first-block-only match was accepted.
representative_large_archive_check.scope: This representative proves the large-file route, not completion of the remaining uploads; final per-file coverage is bound in artifact_manifest.json.

bypy_asset_check.method: Every source SHA256 matches the original packaging registry; every provider size and complete single-entry meta.block_list matches independently computed source size and whole-file MD5. A final scoped directory listing and per-file metadata pass exactly cover the closed 92-file plan.

secrets_gate: All published source text/log/config files were scanned during packaging for private-key and credential token patterns; zero findings. No credentials, private keys, session stores or model weights were packaged.
